newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks edge higher in quiet trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks edge higher in quiet trading.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London edged slightly higher in quiet trading on Monday, pushing ahead from Hong Kong's record close overnight, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London reference index closed at 12,334.27, up 3.92 points. In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng had closed 111.95 points higher at a record 12,330.35.
Traders said the London market was quiet with the only interest focused on HSBC Holdings, which closed at HK$150.4, 90 HK cents above its Hong Kong close.

While traders said the market was beginning to show signs of nervousness after recent gains, the outlook remained bullish and stocks are expected to continue their upward trend, following Wall St and U.S. long bonds.
"The market should continue creeping up. There is a lot of money in the system and more is going to Hong Kong than the other Asian markets," said one trader.
